chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قُلْوَيْهَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَالْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ الثَّمَالِيِّ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashi: Muhammad ibn Qulawayh, from Sa'd ibn Abdallah, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, and Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from his father and al-Husayn ibn Said, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: لَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيْنَا، إِنِّي ذَكَرْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ سَبْإٍ فَقَامَتْ كُلُّ شَعْرَةٍ فِي جَسَدِي، لَقَدْ ادَّعَى أَمْرًا عَظِيمًا مَا لَهُ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ؟ كَانَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَ اللَّهِ عَبْدًا لِلَّهِ صَالِحًا، أَخُو رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَا نَالَ الْكَرَامَةَ مِنَ اللَّهِ إِلَّا بِطَاعَتِهِ لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ، وَمَا نَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْكَرَامَةَ مِنَ اللَّهِ إِلَّا بِطَاعَتِهِ

translations.en: Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) said: 'May Allah curse the one who lies about us. I remembered Abdallah ibn Saba, and every hair on my body stood up. He had claimed a great matter; what is [wrong] with him? May Allah curse him! Ali (peace be upon him) was, by Allah, a righteous slave of Allah, and the brother of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). He did not attain honor from Allah except through his obedience to Allah and His Messenger, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) did not attain honor from Allah except through His obedience.'

en.summary: This narration from Al-Kashi highlights the visceral reaction of Ali ibn al-Husayn (AS) to Abdallah ibn Saba’s claim of divinity, serving as a foundational text for the Ghulat (extremists) in Shia tradition. It underscores the principle that the Ahl al-Bayt’s elevated status is derived not from inherent divinity but from their perfect obedience (ta'ah) to God and the Prophet, distinguishing them from those who exaggerated their status.
en.seo_question: What did Ali ibn al-Husayn say about Abdallah ibn Saba and the source of honor for the Prophet and Ali?

key_terms.عبد الله بن سبإ: Abdallah ibn Saba, a figure known for his claims regarding Ali
key_terms.أَخُو رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: Brother of the Messenger of Allah
